author: RexRegulus
body:
The following is somewhat simplified, potentially biased, and subject to change since several balance updates are imminent:

Grand Summoner is the friendly gateway into T10 content -- Towers, specifically. Most GS players end up converting to Beowulf. Not recommended for PVP, especially live PVP. They are not well liked by the community at large for being easy mode (though interesting builds do exist for them and their Endless set-up takes longer than most other classes can run for).

Beowulf is a very flexible class. Having unique access to level 3 Bestial Bonds and zero gear restrictions leaves lots of room to play your way, whether you want to use your follower to support or you support your follower while it does all the damage. Good at PVP and (non-Endless) farming.

Realmshifter is your physical glass cannon that gets extra turns for no reason and receives stat bonuses on low HP. Risky, but very high reward. Great PVP class, personally not sure about their farming ability. Even with Avidity, I've been told they kind of struggle with hordes but the recent 2H weapon update gave them new tools for that.

Heretic is the magical version of the above but there's a lot less reward for the risk and builds that give some semblance of survivability mean giving up too much firepower. They are otherwise somewhat simple while being great for raid bosses and Endless dungeons. They are also currently in the middle of receiving some much needed help / new abilities.

Gilgamesh is low risk, high reward because Ward = Power. They don't have much build versatility and can't farm very well because farming gear typically doesn't provide Ward. The other option is to lean into their pseudo-AoE ability: Collateral Damage. Another great PVP class.

Deity does it all and does it well. Similar to Beowulf, they have no gear restrictions in addition to passive abilities that randomly provide powerful buffs and increase the duration of those buffs. Unlike Beo, you won't really see them work without proper gear and build knowledge but you otherwise can't go wrong with the class in its current state.

author: Oulanos65
body:
Honestly Beowulf or deity. That’s all right now. They do everything better than the other classes overall and don’t let anybody tell you otherwise. Event Gear is almost given away at this point as there are so many “reruns” of all the important events throughout the year. Before you had to wait next year if you missed an event or Christmas but now every other months you’ve got lots of previous raid boss you could have missed or even Other Realm bosses that gives you tons of stuff whenever it comes.
It’s never been that easy to play orna and be fully geared really.


My advice? Go Beowulf and gear yourself up and switch to deity. That’s the current state of the art. You can do absolutely anything with those two. Summoner is fun and all and I tested it a long time and invested all my ALs and stuff but at the end of the day it’s way too long to do endless and it’s the real endgame.
Also raiding is just way too difficult and weak compared to both other options.

Trust me, do that.

Now, if heretic rework is half as good as deity then ok but right now I don’t think it’s worth investing as a new comer.  Beowulf is simple fast and easy.
